messages.subject: Contribution Bar charts
parts:
Hi,
Is there any way to produce contribution bar charts in ggplot2?
I would like to have category on x-axis and contribution to each category on y-axis rebased to total aggregation so far.
See example chart in the attachment.
 Thank you for your help.

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: Contribution Bar charts
parts:
Perhaps geom_tile could be convinced to do something similar.

http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_tile.html

Or if that doesn't cut it, one could always use geom_polygon.

http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_polygon.html


Cheers,
Roman
